purpose: Teach: 月別/予備校/破損/労災/ストレージ/辞職/役に立っ/明言

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究進捗、月別の振り返り、習慣化しろ。
lines.en: Ren — research progress, monthly check-in. Make it a habit.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Clear beat between clauses. Calm authority without hardness. The voice of someone who has seen what works.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学部時代の予備校通い、研究にも、役立っております。
lines.en: Yes. The discipline from cram school back in undergrad has actually been useful for research too.
lines.style: Careful, slightly self-conscious. Slight pause before 'actually' — checking if the connection makes sense. Earnest without being stiff. Looking for approval.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実験装置の破損、絶対、防げ、慎重に、扱え。
lines.en: Equipment damage — prevent it absolutely. Handle everything carefully.
lines.style: Quiet weight on each phrase. No rush. The tone of someone who knows what happens when people are careless. Not a warning; a fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室での労災、過去、ありませんが、注意します。
lines.en: Yes. The lab hasn't had any workplace accidents so far, but I'll be careful.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment at the start. Slight anxious energy underneath — wants to reassure. Small and sincere, not defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究データのストレージ、バックアップ、徹底しろ。
lines.en: Research data — storage, backup. Make it thorough.
lines.style: Crisp, economical phrasing. Each word lands. Speaking from experience of systems that fail. Direct but not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先生の辞職に伴う、研究室の引っ越し、準備中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're in the middle of preparing for the lab move — it's happening because the professor is leaving.
lines.style: Straightforward factual report. Slight undercurrent of controlled chaos — there's a lot going on but he's managing. No complaining, just stating what's true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手の研究、社会に、本当に、役に立った例、報告会で、紹介しろ。
lines.en: Yes. I'm organizing things now so I can articulate the research theme clearly.
lines.style: Determined, methodical. Small breath before 'now' — showing the effort happening behind the scenes. Genuine commitment in the tempo, not rushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究テーマ、明言できるよう、今、整理しています。
lines.en: In the report meeting — introduce examples of how younger researchers' work actually helps society.
lines.style: Shift to softer, more expansive tone. 'Actually' carries warmth — this matters. Speaking to something beyond the immediate lab. Still composed but with quiet conviction.
